z-m-16-01.title: Shin furuci ne da ke ba da lamba firimiya duk wata lamba da ka saka a matsayin n?
z-m-16-01.topic: Lambobi firimiya da lambobi hadaddun, ƙimomin furuci masu haruffa
z-m-16-01.goal: Ka koyi cewa yin daidai sau da yawa ba ya tabbatar da ‘koyaushe’, ka daidaita matakin tabbacin da bayanai, sannan ka nemo misalin da ya karyata furucin da kanka.
z-m-16-01.material: Wani aboki a ƙungiyar lissafi ya ce, ‘Idan n lamba cikakkiya ce da ba ta gaza 0 ba, kamar 0, 1, 2, ..., ƙimar n×n+n+41 (n sau n da aka ƙara n da 41) koyaushe lamba firimiya ce!’ Lamba firimiya ita ce lambar da ta kai aƙalla 2 kuma masu rabonta kawai su ne 1 da kanta; lambar da ta kai aƙalla 2 amma ba firimiya ba lamba hadaddiya ce.
z-m-16-01.thinking.0: Bambance yawan lokutan da aka gwada da ‘dukkan lokuta’
z-m-16-01.thinking.1: Gyara matakin tabbaci bisa sabbin bayanai
z-m-16-01.prereq.0: Ma'anar lambobi firimiya da hadaddiya (lamba firimiya tana da aƙalla 2, kuma masu rabonta kawai su ne 1 da kanta)
z-m-16-01.prereq.1: Saka lamba a madadin harafin n domin nemo ƙimar furuci (n×n shi ne n a murabba'i)
z-m-16-01.prereq.2: Lissafi ta raba lambobi masu haruffa huɗu ko ƙasa da haka da ƙananan lambobi a jere
z-m-16-01.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Duk lokacin da sabon bayani ya bayyana, zaɓi wanda ya fi kusa da ra'ayinka na yanzu.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane bayanin da aka bayar, ka bambanta ‘ƙimar n da ka gwada’ da ‘ƙimar n da ba ka gwada ba tukuna.’
z-m-16-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin abin da ake buƙata domin magana kan ‘dukkan n’, ba kawai yawan n da ka gwada zuwa yanzu ba.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Idan aka saka n=1, 2, 3, 4, 5, ƙimomin su ne 43, 47, 53, 61, 71. Dukkan biyar lambobi firimiya ne.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yanzu me kake tunani game da ikirarin abokinka?
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Gwaje-gwaje biyar alama ce da ke goyon bayan ikirarin. Amma akwai n marasa iyaka, saboda haka don cewa ‘koyaushe’, dole ne a gwada ƙari ko a nemo dalili.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Dukkan biyar sun zama firimiya, saboda haka za mu iya cewa ƙimar firimiya ce ga kowane n
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Yin daidai sau biyar alama ce kawai, ba gwajin dukkan n ba. Me kuma ake buƙata kafin a yi magana kan ‘dukkan n’?
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Da alama mai yiwuwa ne, amma ina son gwada ko yana aiki ga manyan ƙimar n ma
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka yarda da alamar, kuma ka yi tunani cewa akwai ƙimomin n da yawa da ba ka gwada ba tukuna.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ya yi daidai ne ga ƙananan ƙimomin n kawai, amma tabbas ga manyan n lamba hadaddiya za ta fito
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Har yanzu babu hujja cewa ba ya aiki ga manyan ƙimomin n. Kafin gwadawa, ba za ka iya tabbatarwa ta kowace hanya ba.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ba za mu iya sanin komai game da wannan furuci daga lokuta biyar kawai ba
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Kasancewar duk lokuta biyar sun zama firimiya ma bayani ne. Ka yanke shawarar yadda za ka yarda da shi.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Shirin kwamfuta ya lissafta ƙimomi 40 duka daga n=0 zuwa n=39, kuma kowace ƙima lamba firimiya ce.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yanzu yaya kake kallon ikirarin abokinka?
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Ko da duk ƙimomi 40 daidai ne, wannan ba hujja ba ce. Ya dace a kira shi hasashe mai yiwuwa.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Dukkansu 40 sun zama prime, saboda haka yanzu za mu iya cewa 'koyaushe prime ne'.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: 40 adadi ne mai yawa, amma har yanzu akwai ƙimomin n da suka fi 40. Ko da adadin da aka bincika babba ne, ba ka bincika 'duk n' ba.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Daga n=40 zuwa gaba, lokaci ne na lambobin hadaddun su fito.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kasancewar daidai a baya ba ya nufin yanzu 'lokaci ne' na yin kuskure. Akwai dalilin da ya sa kake ganin haka?
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Hasashe ne mai yiwuwa, amma ba mu sani ba tukuna ko yana aiki ga duk n.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ya kiyaye cewa yayin da bincike ke ƙaruwa amincewa tana ƙaruwa, amma 'duk' yana buƙatar dalili ko bincika komai.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Mun bincika 40, ba sai mun duba n=41 da bayansa ba.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Abin da ka bincika ba duka ba ne. Har yanzu akwai ɓangaren da ba a bincika ba.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Me wannan sakamakon yake nuna maka game da maganar abokinka?
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.after: 1681=41×41 ba lamba prime ba ce. Misali guda yana nuna 'koyaushe prime' ba ya tabbata.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 40 na farko duka prime ne, saboda haka lissafin n=40 dole ya yi kuskure.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Idan kana shakkar lissafi za ka iya sake lissafawa. Kada ka watsar da sabon sakamako kawai domin sakamakon baya da yawa ne.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Daga yanzu dole mu ce lambobin hadaddun suna fitowa ga duk n.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka yi gama-gari akasin haka. Nemo yanayi guda ba ya sa duk sauran yanayi su zama akasin.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: n=40 kaɗai ne banda, saboda haka za mu iya cewa ga mafi yawan n yana prime.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ba a bincika 'mafi yawan' ba tukuna ma. Kana buƙatar gano ko lambobin hadaddun suna fitowa ga n=41 da bayansa.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Lamba hadadda ta fito ga n=40, saboda haka 'koyaushe prime' ba gaskiya ba ce.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ka san cewa misali guda yana karya 'koyaushe', ka kuma karɓi sabon sakamako yadda yake.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.reflect: Ta yaya tabbacin ka ya canza lokacin da aka ga sakamako har zuwa n=5, har zuwa 39, sannan n=40? Menene bambancin taruwar misalai da suka yi daidai da misali guda mara daidai?
z-m-16-01.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ƙimomin n mabambanta guda 2, n cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 0 zuwa 100, inda n×n+n+41 ba lamba prime ba ce (hadadda ce), ka shigar da su.
z-m-16-01.s.s2.hint.0: Har zuwa n=39 dukkansu prime ne. Lissafa ƙimomi a jere daga n na gaba.
z-m-16-01.s.s2.hint.1: Idan ƙima babba ce, bincika ko ana iya raba ta da 2,3,5,7,... a jere. Lambobi: 2, 3, 5, 7.
z-m-16-01.s.s2.ok.c1: n cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 0 zuwa 100.
z-m-16-01.s.s2.fail.c1: n ba cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 0 zuwa 100 ba.
z-m-16-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ga wannan n ƙimar prime ce. Nemi wani n.
z-m-16-01.s.s2.explain: Idan n=40, 1681=41×41; n=41, 41×41+41+41=1763=41×43; n=44 kuma 2021=43×47, saboda haka lambobin hadaddun suna fitowa. Ko da yanayi 40 sun yi daidai, misali mai karyatawa ya zo nan da nan bayansu.
z-m-16-01.s.s3.prompt: Kana son gaya wa abokin kulobinka: 'Ko da ta zama prime ga kowane n daga 0 zuwa 39, kada ka ce koyaushe prime ce.' Rubuta dalilin ta amfani da aƙalla ƙimar n ɗaya da ka samo a sama.
z-m-16-01.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta n ɗaya da ka samo da sakamakon lissafinsa.
z-m-16-01.s.s3.hint.1: Nuna kalmar ('koyaushe') a maganar abokinka da sakamakon bai dace da ita ba.
z-m-16-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: A bayyane yake ƙimar ba prime ba ce ga n ɗin da ka bayar?
z-m-16-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka haɗa cewa 'na bincika da yawa' da 'na bincika duk yanayi' abubuwa ne dabam?
z-m-16-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka faɗi cewa misali guda ma yana karya 'koyaushe'?
z-m-16-01.s.s3.model.0: Idan n=40, 1681=41×41, saboda haka ba prime ba ce. Ko da ƙimomi 40 prime ne, idan n guda ɗaya ya fito haka, 'koyaushe prime' ya zama ƙarya.
z-m-16-01.s.s3.model.1: Ko da ka bincika nawa, ba ka bincika duk n ba. A zahiri idan n=41, 41×43=1763 ne, lambar hadadda, saboda haka kada ka ce 'koyaushe'.
z-m-16-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ya ƙunshi ra'ayoyin biyu: misali guda mai karyatawa, da 'dukkan yanayi ba adadi kaɗai ba'.

z-m-16-02.thinking.1: Ƙirƙirar yanayi da dama da suka cika sharuddan.
z-m-16-02.title: Lokacin da bas biyu za su fara sake tashi tare.
z-m-16-02.topic: Amfani da ninkin lambobi da ninkin gama-gari.
z-m-16-02.goal: Bambanta ƙima da suka dace tare da ƙimar da suka dace 'a karo na farko'; tsara ma'auratan tazara da suka cika sharudda da kanka, ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa yanayin da ba zai yiwu ba ba zai yiwu ba.
z-m-16-02.material: A tashar bas guda, bas na hanya 가 yana tashi kowane minti 12, na hanya 나 kuma kowane minti 18. Yau daidai ƙarfe 9 na safe bas ɗin biyu sun tashi tare, daga nan kowace hanya ta ci gaba da tazara iri ɗaya. Harin ta ce, 'Bayan minti 12×18=216, wato ninka tazarorin biyun, a 12:36 na rana za su sake tashi tare a karon farko!'
z-m-16-02.thinking.0: Bambanta 'a lokaci ɗaya' da 'a karon farko' a amsar wani.
z-m-16-02.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa wani abu ba zai yiwu ba.
z-m-16-02.prereq.0: Ma'anar ninkin lamba da jera ninkin lamba.
z-m-16-02.prereq.1: Lissafin lokaci a sa'o'i da mintuna (mayar da mintuna zuwa lokacin yini).
z-m-16-02.s.s1.prompt: Ka duba abin da Harin ta ce. Zaɓi kimantawa mafi dacewa.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta lokutan tashi na hanya 가 (minti) kamar 12,24,..., hanya 나 kuma dabam. Lokutan: 12, 24, ...
z-m-16-02.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo lokutan da suka bayyana a layukan biyu duka, ka duba wanda ya zo farko.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.o.a: Bayan minti 12+18=30, jimillar tazarorin biyun, ne lokacin da za su sake tashi tare a karon farko.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.r.a: Duba ko bas na hanya 가 yana tashi bayan minti 30. Yana tashi kowane tazara minti 12.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.o.b: Za su tashi tare a karo na farko bayan minti 18, tazara mafi tsawo.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.r.b: Bas na hanya 나 yana tashi bayan minti 18. Duba ko bas na hanya 가 yana tashi a minti 18.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.o.c: Bayan minti 216 daidai ne. Lokacin da aka samu ta ninka tazarorin shi ne lokacin da za su tashi tare a karon farko.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.r.c: Gaskiya ne cewa hanyoyin biyu za su tashi a mintin da aka ninka. Amma ka bincika ko babu lokacin da ya gabata da za su tashi tare?
z-m-16-02.s.s1.o.d: Za su tashi tare bayan minti 216 ma, amma akwai lokacin da ya gabata, saboda haka ba 'na farko' ba ne.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.r.d: Ka bambanta 'lokacin da bas ɗin biyu ke tashi' da 'lokaci na farko da suke tashi tare'.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.explain: Ninkin 12 su ne 12,24,36,..., ninkin 18 kuma 18,36,54,...; saboda haka za su tashi tare a karo na farko bayan minti 36 (9:36). 216 minti ninkin 36 sau 6 ne, saboda haka za su tashi tare a wancan lokacin ma, amma ba 'na farko' ba ne. Ninkin: 12, 24, 36, ...; 18, 36, 54, ...; minti 216, minti 36, sau 6.
z-m-16-02.s.s2.prompt: Ga shirin sabbin hanyoyi. Hanyoyin biyu sun tashi tare ƙarfe 9 na safe, karo na gaba da za su tashi tare a karon farko kuma ya zama 9:36 (minti 36 bayan haka). Yanke tazarar hanyar 가 minti a, ta hanyar 나 minti b. a da b cikakkun lambobi ne daga 2 zuwa 36, a kuma ya gaza b. Nemo ma'aurata (a,b) mabambanta guda 3.
z-m-16-02.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi ma'aurata ɗaya kamar a=6,b=9, rubuta lokutan tashi na kowace hanya, nemo lokacin farko da suka haɗu.
z-m-16-02.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta abin da ya kamata ka canza idan lokacin haɗuwa na farko ya gaza minti 36 da abin da za ka canza idan ya wuce minti 36.
z-m-16-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a da b dole cikakkun lambobi ne daga 2 zuwa 36, kuma a<b.
z-m-16-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Lokacin farko da suke tashi tare daidai minti 36 bayan haka ne.
z-m-16-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Lokacin farko da suke tashi tare ba minti 36 ba ne. Jera ninkin tazarorin biyun, ka duba.
z-m-16-02.s.s2.explain: Misali ga (4,9), ninkin 4 (4,8,...,36) da na 9 (9,18,27,36) sun fara haɗuwa a 36. (12,18) shi ne yanayin asali. Ma'auratan da suka haɗu kafin 36 ((6,9) suna haɗuwa bayan minti 18) ko waɗanda suka wuce 36 ((5,7) suna haɗuwa bayan 35) ba su cika sharudda ba. (4, 9): 4, 8, ..., 36; 9, 18, 27, 36. (12, 18). (6, 9) minti 18; (5, 7) minti 35.
z-m-16-02.s.s3.prompt: Idan tazarar hanyar 나 minti 8 ce, za ka iya sa su tashi tare a karon farko 9:36 duk yadda ka sa tazarar hanyar 가? Rubuta hukuncinka da dalilinsa.
z-m-16-02.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta lokutan tashi na hanya 나 (tazara minti 8) kamar 8,16,... Jerin: 8, 16, ...
z-m-16-02.s.s3.hint.1: Duba ko 36 yana cikin waɗannan lokutan.
z-m-16-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Dalilinka ya bayyana ne ta tazara minti 8 ta hanyar 나 kaɗai, ko labarin gwada tazarori daban-daban na hanyar 가?
z-m-16-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka faɗi ko hanyar 나 tana tashi a minti 36?
z-m-16-02.s.s3.model.0: Ba zai yiwu ba. Hanyar 나 tana tashi a minti 0,8,16,24,32,40, don haka ba ta tashi a minti 36. Dalili shi ne 36 ba ninkin 8 ba ne. Lokutan: 0, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40; 36÷8=4.5.
z-m-16-02.s.s3.model.1: Ba zai yiwu ba. 36÷8=4.5, ba ya rabuwa daidai. Idan hanyar 나 ba ta tashi a minti 36, ko da wane yanayi aka tsara hanyar 가 ba za su iya tashi tare a minti 36 ba.
z-m-16-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Wata hanya ce ta bayyana ta amfani da rabo.

z-m-16-03.title: Nemo zangon cikakkun lambobi jere-jere da jimillarsu 10.
z-m-16-03.topic: Haɗa cikakkun lambobi da lambobin kishiyarsu.
z-m-16-03.goal: Yi amfani da sifar cewa lambobi masu kishiyar juna idan aka haɗa su 0 ne a jimillar lambobi jere-jere masu haɗa tabbatattu da marasa kyau, nemo zango da dama da suka cika sharudda, ka bayyana dalilin.
z-m-16-03.material: A ɗauki S(s,e) a matsayin ƙimar da ake samu idan aka haɗa dukkan cikakkun lambobi ɗaya bayan ɗaya daga s zuwa e (s cikakkiyar lamba ce da ba ta fi e girma ba). Misali idan s=−2, e=3, jimilla (−2)+(−1)+0+1+2+3=3 ce. 0 ma cikakkiyar lamba ce, kuma ana haɗa s da e.
z-m-16-03.thinking.0: Gano tsarin da ke rage wahalar lissafi.
z-m-16-03.thinking.1: Nemo mafita da dama da suka cika takurawa.
z-m-16-03.thinking.2: Bayyana da kalmomi hanyar da ka gano.
z-m-16-03.prereq.0: Haɗa cikakkun lambobi (har da marasa kyau).
z-m-16-03.prereq.1: Jimillar lambobi biyu masu cikakkiyar ƙima iri ɗaya amma alamu kishiyoyi.
z-m-16-03.s.s1.prompt: Menene S(−3,5), wato jimillar dukkan cikakkun lambobi daga −3 zuwa 5? Zaɓi yayin tunanin ko akwai hanyar nemo ta ba tare da haɗawa ɗaya bayan ɗaya ba. S(−3, 5).
z-m-16-03.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta duk lambobi daga −3 zuwa 5, ka haɗa da layi lambobin da cikakkiyar ƙimarsu iri ɗaya.
z-m-16-03.s.s1.hint.1: Haɗa lambobin da ba a haɗa su biyu-biyu kawai.
z-m-16-03.s.s1.r.a: Za ka iya bayyana yadda ka yi amfani da lambobin da suka zama ma'aurata? Idan ka warware ta haka, ka ga tsarin da kyau.
z-m-16-03.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ita ce jimillar lambobin ƙarshen biyu kaɗai, −3 da 5. Dole ne ka haɗa lambobin tsakiya ma.
z-m-16-03.s.s1.r.c: Wannan ita ce jimillar lambobi masu kyau 1 zuwa 5 kawai. Lambobin marasa kyau da 0 ma ana haɗa su.
z-m-16-03.s.s1.r.d: Daga −3 zuwa 3 sun soke juna, 4 da 5 suka rage.
z-m-16-03.s.s1.explain: −3 da 3, −2 da 2, −1 da 1 jimillarsu 0 ce, ƙara 0 ba ya canza komai. Ƙara 4 da 5 da suka rage ya ba 9.
z-m-16-03.s.s2.prompt: Nemo (s,e) mabambanta guda 3, s da e cikakkun lambobi ne daga −20 zuwa 20 (s bai fi e girma ba), inda S(s,e) daidai yake da 10, ka shigar da su.
z-m-16-03.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi lambar farawa, ƙara lambar ƙarshe da 1 kowane lokaci, ka rubuta jimilloli a jere.
z-m-16-03.s.s2.hint.1: Duba waɗanne lambobi ke soke juna idan ka fara haɗa lambobi marasa kyau.
z-m-16-03.s.s2.ok.c1: s da e cikakkun lambobi ne daga −20 zuwa 20, s kuma ba ta fi e girma ba.
z-m-16-03.s.s2.fail.c1: s da e cikakkun lambobi ne daga −20 zuwa 20, s ba za ta fi e girma ba.
z-m-16-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Jimillar daga s zuwa e 10 ce.
z-m-16-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Jimillar dukkan lambobi daga s zuwa e ba 10 ba ce. Duba yawan lambobin da kake haɗawa ma.
z-m-16-03.s.s2.explain: A wannan zangon akwai zanguna huɗu da jimillarsu 10: (1,4), (0,4), (10,10), (−9,10). (−9,10) yanayi ne inda −9 zuwa 9 suka soke juna, 10 kaɗai ya rage. (1, 4), (0, 4), (10, 10), (−9, 10), −9 zuwa 9, 10.
z-m-16-03.s.s3.prompt: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa S(−9,10)=10 ba tare da haɗa lambobi 20 ɗin duka ba. S(−9, 10)=10.
z-m-16-03.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta duk lambobi daga −9 zuwa 10, ka yi ma'aurata ga waɗanda cikakkiyar ƙimarsu ɗaya ce.
z-m-16-03.s.s3.hint.1: Nemo ko akwai lambar da ba za a iya haɗa wa abokiya ba.
z-m-16-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta takamaiman lambobin da suka zama ma'aurata?
z-m-16-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka faɗi lambar da ta rage ba tare da abokiya ba da dalilin da ya sa ta rage?
z-m-16-03.s.s3.model.0: Lambobi masu cikakkiyar ƙima ɗaya da alamu kishiyoyi kamar −9 da 9, −8 da 8 jimillarsu 0 ce. Ƙara 0 ba ya canza, 10 kaɗai ne ba shi da abokiya ya rage, jimilla 10 ce.
z-m-16-03.s.s3.model.1: Lambobin marasa kyau −9 zuwa −1 suna yin ma'aurata ɗaya bayan ɗaya da tabbatattun 1 zuwa 9, jimillarsu 0 ce. Abin da ya rage 0 da 10 ne, jimilla 10 ce.
z-m-16-03.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ya bayyana takamaiman zangon da aka haɗa biyu-biyu.

z-m-16-04.title: Zaɓar ma'aunin da zai sa mafita ta zama cikakkiyar lamba.

z-m-16-05.title: Rangwame da kupon: shin ƙima tana canzawa bisa jerin amfani da su?
z-m-16-05.topic: Kwatanta hanyoyi biyu ta amfani da furuci mai harafi
z-m-16-05.thinking.1: Kwatanta hanyoyi biyu ta amfani da furuci mai harafi
z-m-16-05.goal: Ka lissafta ka kwatanta ƙimomin hanyoyi biyu ga farashi da dama, ka yi amfani da harafin x wajen bayyana bambancin, ka bincika ko bambancin tsayayye ne ba tare da la'akari da farashi ba, sannan ka bincika iyakar da furucin yake aiki a cikinta.
z-m-16-05.material: Kana son sayen kaya mai farashin jeri x원 a kantin yanar gizo. Da farko za mu duba yanayin da x lambar cikakkiya ce ta 2000 ko fiye. Hanya A ita ce fara rage 20%, sannan a yi amfani da kupon 1000원 a kan wannan farashin; hanya B ita ce fara amfani da kupon 1000원, sannan a rage 20% daga wannan farashin.

z-m-16-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: A zai fi araha. Ko farashin jeri ya canza, da alama gefe ɗaya zai ci gaba da zama mai rahusa.
z-m-16-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ka yi hasashen cewa sakamakon da aka gani ga farashi ɗaya zai shafi sauran farashin. Za ka iya bincika ta hanyar sauya farashin jeri da yin lissafi.
z-m-16-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Idan farashin jeri ya canza, B na iya zama mai rahusa
z-m-16-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka bar yiwuwar cewa misali ɗaya zai iya sauya hukunci a buɗe. Za ka iya gano ta ta gwada wani farashin jeri dabam.
z-m-16-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ƙimar hanyoyin biyu iri ɗaya ce ko da wane ne farashin jeri
z-m-16-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: A farashin 2000원 sun riga sun bambanta, 600원 da 800원. Ta yaya za ka gwada wannan misalin da wannan ra'ayi?
z-m-16-05.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Idan ba mu san farashin jeri ba, ba za mu iya faɗin wanne ya fi araha ba
z-m-16-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Idan ka zaɓi farashin jeri ɗaya ka yi lissafi, za ka samu alama. Yi amfani da sakamakon farashin 2000원.

z-m-16-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ka bincika sau biyu kawai. Har yanzu ba ka san yadda yake ga sauran farashin jeri ba (misali, 4000원 ko 100000원).
z-m-16-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Mu rubuta da harafi. Ƙimar A ita ce 0.8x−1000. Ƙimar B kuwa ita ce (x−1000)×0.8, wadda idan aka sauƙaƙa ta zama 0.8x−800.

z-m-16-05.s.s1.st.2.after: (0.8x−800)−(0.8x−1000)=200. Sharuɗɗan da ke ɗauke da x sun soke juna, saboda haka ko wane ne farashin jeri (cikin iyakar da furucin yake aiki), A ya fi araha da 200원.

z-m-16-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka cire furucin da kanka. Ka bincika ko wani shardi mai ɗauke da x ya rage.

z-m-16-07.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayani ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane lokaci, zaɓi abin da ya fi kusa da tunaninka na yanzu.
z-m-16-07.title: Tafiyar dawowa da gudu daban-daban a tafiya da dawowa: menene matsakaicin gudu?
z-m-16-07.topic: Gudu, lokaci, tazara, da furuci masu haruffa
z-m-16-07.goal: Ka bincika ta amfani da misalai da furuci mai harafi ko sakamakon yana tsayayye ko da ba a bayar da tazara ba, sannan ka fahimci adadin da ake rabawa da shi yayin nemo matsakaici.
z-m-16-07.material: Jiho tana tafiya daga gida zuwa ɗakin karatu da gudun 4km a awa guda (4km cikin awa 1), sannan ta dawo ta hanya ɗaya da gudun 6km a awa guda. Ba ta huta a kowane ɓangare ba, kuma gudunta bai canza ba. An bayyana ‘matsakaicin gudun tafiyar dawowa’ da (jimillar tazarar tafiyar dawowa)÷(jimillar lokacin tafiyar dawowa). Ba a bayar da tazarar da ke tsakanin gida da ɗakin karatu ba.
z-m-16-07.thinking.0: Yanke shawarar irin bayanin da ake buƙata a matsalar da da alama ta rasa bayani
z-m-16-07.thinking.1: Faɗaɗa daga misalai zuwa furuci mai harafi
z-m-16-07.thinking.2: Nemo kuskure a warwarewa ta hanyar saɓanin sakamakon
z-m-16-07.s.s1.hint.0: Zaɓi tazara, sannan ka lissafta lokacin tafiya zuwa wurin da lokacin dawowa.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ka canza tazara, ka sake lissafa, sannan ka kwatanta sakamakon.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Har yanzu ba mu san tazara ba. Tana tafiya da 4km a awa guda zuwa wurin, da 6km a awa guda tana dawowa.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yanzu me kake tunani game da matsakaicin gudun tafiyar dawowa?
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.after: Har yanzu ba mu san tazara ba, saboda haka ya yi wuri a bayar da ƙima daidai. Ana iya gwada hasashen cewa yana tsakanin 4 da 6, da kuma tunanin cewa ana buƙatar sanin tazara.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Zai zama 5km a awa guda, daidai tsakiyar 4 da 6
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Akwai dalilin ganin cewa daidai tsakiyar ne kuwa? Wannan yana nufin ka ɗauka lokacin tafiya da 4km/h da lokacin tafiya da 6km/h iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Da alama ƙima ce tsakanin 4 da 6, amma muna buƙatar ƙarin bayani domin nemo ainihin ƙimar
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Tunanin cewa yana tsakanin gudun ɓangarorin biyun yana da ma'ana. Ka kuma yi tunanin abin da ake buƙata domin nemo ainihin ƙimar.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ba mu san tazara ba, saboda haka da alama ba za mu iya nemo matsakaicin gudu ba
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Yana da ma'ana a ga kamar ana buƙatar tazara. Idan ka ɗauka akwai wata tazara ka yi lissafi, za ka iya bincika ko ana buƙatarta da gaske.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Zai fi 6km a awa guda sauri
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Matsakaici ne na jimillar tafiyar dawowa da aka raba da lokacin da aka ɗauka. Ka yi tunanin ko gudun zai iya fi gudu mafi sauri.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.1.info: Mu ɗauka tazarar 12km ce. Tafiya zuwa wurin tana ɗaukar 12÷4=3 awa, dawowa kuma 12÷6=2 awa. Saboda haka ta yi tafiyar dawowa ta 24km cikin awa 5.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: To, menene matsakaicin gudun tafiyar dawowa, a km a awa guda?
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.1.after: 24÷5=4.8. Matsakaicin gudu ba matsakaicin gudun biyun ba ne, jimillar tazara ce da aka raba da jimillar lokaci.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: 5 daidai tsakiyar 4 da 6 ne. Ka raba da kanka don ganin gudun km a awa guda idan ta yi tafiyar 24km cikin awa 5.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Duba yadda ka samu wannan ƙima. Lissafa 24÷5.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Sake lissafa 24÷5. Duba ko ya dace da wannan ƙima.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ka raba jimillar tafiyar ida-da-komo da jimillar lokaci. Ba ka yi matsakaicin saurin sassan kawai ba.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.info: Idan nisan 24km ne, tafiya tana ɗaukar 24÷4=6 sa'o'i, dawowa kuma 24÷6=4, jimilla awanni 10 ne, tafiyar ida-da-komo kuma 48km ce. Matsakaicin gudu 48÷10=4.8 ne, wato 4.8km a awa.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mu koma farko. Idan ba ka san nisa ba, me za ka ce game da matsakaicin saurin tafiya ida-da-komo?
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Ya kasance 4.8km/h sau biyun, saboda haka wataƙila iri ɗaya ne ko da nisa ya bambanta. Kafin a bincika ta kira nisa d, ya yi da wuri a ce iri ɗaya ce ga kowane nisa.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Za a iya nemo shi ne idan mun san nisa.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ya kasance 4.8 ga 12km da 24km duka. Ta yaya za ka bayyana cewa sakamako iri ɗaya ya fito duk da nisan ya bambanta?
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ya zama 4.8 sau biyun, saboda haka da alama 4.8 ne ko da nisa ya bambanta.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka ɗauki ƙima ɗaya da ta fito a misalai biyu a matsayin alama. Kana buƙatar gwada da harafi ko tana aiki ga kowane nisa.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Yayin da nisa ya ƙaru, matsakaicin sauri ya fi girma.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Matsakaicin gudu 12km da 24km iri ɗaya ne. Bai ƙaru ba.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Yanayi biyu kawai na duba, saboda haka ina so in kira nisan d km in bincika ko iri ɗaya ne ga kowane nisa.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan hali ne na bincika da harafi kafin faɗaɗa daga misalai biyu.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.reflect: Ta yaya tunaninka ya canza a hasashen farko, lokacin da ka ɗauki nisa 12km, da lokacin da ka ɗauki 24km? 'Matsala ce da ba a san nisa ba', amma da gaske ana buƙatar nisa?
z-m-16-07.s.s2.prompt: Wannan maganin Jiho ne, ya kira nisa d km. Zaɓi layi guda da ba za a amince da shi ba. (Za ka iya zaɓar layin da lissafinsa ba daidai ba ne ko ƙarshe mara kyau da aka rubuta sakamakon haka.)
z-m-16-07.s.s2.hint.0: Kwatanta sakamakon maganin da wanda aka lissafa da wuri ga 12km.
z-m-16-07.s.s2.hint.1: Duba layi-layi ko kowanne ya biyo daga layin baya, ka sake lissafa.
z-m-16-07.s.s2.line.0: A ce nisan gida zuwa ɗakin karatu d km ne.
z-m-16-07.s.s2.line.1: Lokacin tafiya d÷4=d/4 (awanni), lokacin dawowa d÷6=d/6 (awanni) ne.
z-m-16-07.s.s2.line.2: Jimillar lokacin tafiya ida-da-komo d/4+d/6=2d/10=d/5 (awanni) ce.
z-m-16-07.s.s2.line.3: Nisan ida-da-komo 2d km ne, saboda haka matsakaicin gudu 2d÷(d/5)=10 (km/h) ne.
z-m-16-07.s.s2.line.4: Saboda haka, ko da nisa ya bambanta, matsakaicin gudu 10km a awa ne.
z-m-16-07.s.s2.explain: Kuskuren yana layi na 3. d/4+d/6 ya kamata a mayar da suna lambar ƙasa ɗaya: 3d/12+2d/12=5d/12 (awanni). Kada a haɗa lambobin sama da ƙasa tare. Sannan matsakaicin gudu 2d÷(5d/12)=24/5=4.8 (km/h) ne, d kuma tana gogewa, saboda haka iri ɗaya ne ko da nisa ya bambanta. 10km/h na layuka 4 da 5 ya gaji kuskuren layi na 3, ya bambanta da 4.8 da aka samu a baya, saboda haka za a iya yin shakku. Hanyar tunani cewa 'bai danganta da nisa ba' daidai ce.
z-m-16-07.s.s3.prompt: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa matsakaicin saurin tafiya ida-da-komo 4.8 ne, ƙasa da 5, ba 5 a daidai tsakiya tsakanin 4 da 6 ba, ta mai da hankali ga lokacin tafiya da na dawowa.
z-m-16-07.s.s3.hint.0: Kwatanta lokacin da tafiya ta ɗauka da na dawowa.
z-m-16-07.s.s3.hint.1: Duba a wane gudu take tafiya na dogon lokaci, ka yi tunanin matsakaici zai fi karkata ga wane gefe.
z-m-16-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka haɗa gaskiyar cewa 'lokaci ya fi tsawo' da ƙarshe cewa 'matsakaici yana kusa da gudu mai hankali'?
z-m-16-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Idan ka ba da misali bayyananne kamar 12km, ka rubuta daidai ƙimomi kamar tafiya awanni 3 da dawowa awanni 2?
z-m-16-07.s.s3.model.0: Tafiya a hankali take ɗaukar tsawon lokaci. A cikin jimillar lokaci an fi yin tafiya da 4km a awa, saboda haka matsakaici 4.8 ne, ya karkata ga 4 maimakon 5.
z-m-16-07.s.s3.model.1: Idan nisa 12km ne, tafiya tana ɗaukar awanni 3, dawowa awanni 2. Lokacin gudu 4km a awa ya fi tsawo, saboda haka wannan saurin yana shafar matsakaici fiye, ya zama ƙasa da 5.
z-m-16-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: An bayyana ta da misali bayyananne.

z-m-16-08.title: Za mu iya kiran wannan dangantaka aiki (function)?
z-m-16-08.topic: Ma'anar aiki (dangantakar da ke kayyade ƙima ɗaya bayan ɗaya).
z-m-16-08.goal: Yanke ko abu aiki ne bisa ko an kayyade ƙimar y guda ɗaya daidai ga kowace ƙimar x, nuna da misali mai karyatawa dangantakar da ba aiki ba ce, ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa x daban-daban na iya samun y ɗaya.
z-m-16-08.material: Ƙa'idar da ta danganta ƙimar y da kowace ƙimar x da ka zaɓa ana kiranta 'dangantaka'. Idan an kayyade ƙimar y guda ɗaya daidai ga kowace ƙimar x, y ana kiranta aiki na x. (Idan da zarar an zaɓi x, ƙimomin y biyu ko fiye suka fito, ba aiki ba ne.)
z-m-16-08.thinking.0: Duba sharuddan ma'ana ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
z-m-16-08.thinking.1: Ka ƙirƙiri misali mai karyatawa domin nuna ba aiki ba ne.
z-m-16-08.thinking.2: Bambanta abin da aka yarda da wanda ba a yarda ba.
z-m-16-08.prereq.0: Ma'anar cikakkun lambobi masu kyau, masu rabawa, ninki, da saura.
z-m-16-08.prereq.1: Ma'anar dangantaka a matsayin 'ƙa'idar da ke haɗa ƙimomin y da ƙimomin x'.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.prompt: Idan x cikakkiyar lamba mai kyau ce, zaɓi duk dangantakar da y yake aiki na x.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.hint.0: Saka ƴan ƙananan cikakkun lambobi a matsayin x, ka rubuta a tebur y nawa suka fito.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo ko akwai ko da x guda ɗaya da ke ba da y biyu ko fiye.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.o.a: A ce y mai rabawa ne na x.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.r.a: Idan x=6, y na iya zama ƙimomi da dama: 1,2,3,6. Ƙirga y nawa ke dacewa da x guda ɗaya. x=6: y=1, 2, 3, 6.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.o.b: A ce y ragowar rabo ne idan aka raba x da 6.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.r.b: Da zarar an zaɓi x, ragowar ƙima guda ce. Idan ka zaɓi wannan bayan ka duba, ka yi amfani da ma'anar da kyau.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.o.c: A ce y cikakkiyar lamba ce mai kyau da ta gaza x.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.r.c: Idan x=4, y ƙimomi da dama ce: 1,2,3. x=4: y=1, 2, 3.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.o.d: A ce y lambar da ta fi sau 2 na x da 1.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.r.d: Da zarar an zaɓi x, y an kayyade a matsayin ƙima guda 2x+1.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.o.e: A ce y ninkin x ne.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.r.e: Idan x=3, y ƙimomi da dama ne: 3,6,9,... x=3: y=3, 6, 9, ...
z-m-16-08.s.s1.explain: Ga b da d, y ƙima ɗaya ce da aka kayyade da zarar an zaɓi x. Ga a,c,e kuwa y da dama suna fitowa ga x guda, kamar x=6,4,3; saboda haka ba ayyuka ba ne. x=6, 4, 3.
z-m-16-08.s.s2.prompt: Ga shekarun x da tsayin y cm, an ce 'dangantakar da ke zaɓar ɗalibi ɗaya, ta haɗa tsayin ɗalibin y da shekarunsa x' ba aiki ba ce. Yi misalai mabambanta guda 2 da ke nuna dalili. Shigar da (shekaru, tsawo) na ɗalibai biyu masu shekaru iri ɗaya. (Shekaru cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 8 zuwa 19, tsayi kuma daga 120 zuwa 200; tsayin ɗalibi na farko y1 ya gaza na biyu y2.)
z-m-16-08.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko yi tunanin ɗalibai biyu masu shekaru iri ɗaya, ka sa tsayinsu ya bambanta.
z-m-16-08.s.s2.hint.1: Tabbatar sharuddan biyu, shekaru ɗaya da tsayi dabam, sun cika.
z-m-16-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Shekaru dole cikakkiyar lamba ce daga 8 zuwa 19, tsayi kuma cikakkiyar lamba daga 120 zuwa 200.
z-m-16-08.s.s2.ok.c2: Daliban biyu shekarunsu iri ɗaya ne.
z-m-16-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Dole ɗaliban biyu su kasance masu shekaru iri ɗaya.
z-m-16-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Tsayin ɗalibi na farko dole ya gaza na biyu (dole su bambanta).
z-m-16-08.s.s2.explain: Idan akwai ɗalibai masu shekaru 13 da tsayi 155cm da 162cm, y ba a kayyade a matsayin guda ɗaya ga x=13 ba. Saboda haka wannan dangantaka ba aiki ba ce. Daliban masu shekaru dabam ba za su zama misali mai karyatawa ba.
z-m-16-08.s.s3.prompt: Idan x cikakkiyar lamba mai kyau ce, a ce 'y ragowar rabo ne idan aka raba x da 6'; y=1 idan x=7, y=1 ma idan x=13. Shin x dabam-dabam da suke da y iri ɗaya ya saɓa wa sharadin aiki? Rubuta hukuncinka da dalilinsa.
z-m-16-08.s.s3.hint.0: Ƙirga y nawa ne idan x=7, da y nawa idan x=13.
z-m-16-08.s.s3.hint.1: Sake karanta jimlar da ke bayyana aiki a wannan aikin, yi alama ga abin da 'guda ɗaya' ke nufi.
z-m-16-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka faɗi ko y guda ɗaya ne haddii x=7, da haddii x=13?
z-m-16-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bambanta 'y guda ɗaya ta bayyana sau biyu' da 'y biyu ga x guda'?
z-m-16-08.s.s3.model.0: Ba ya saɓa. Aiki yana buƙatar y guda ɗaya da aka kayyade ga kowane x. Idan x=7, y guda 1 ne; idan x=13 ma guda 1 ne, saboda haka babu matsala.
z-m-16-08.s.s3.model.1: Babu matsala. Ƙa'idar tana duba ko y guda ɗaya ta fito da zarar x an zaɓa, don haka x dabam na iya samun y ɗaya. Amma idan y biyu suka fito ga x guda, ba aiki ba ne.

z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yanzu me kake tunani game da ikirarin abokinka?
z-m-16-09.title: Jadawalin kai tsaye y=ax mai a mafi girma yana sama koyaushe?
z-m-16-09.topic: Kwatanta ƙimomin dangantakar kai tsaye y=ax.
z-m-16-09.goal: Gwada da misalai cewa sakamakon kwatanta ƙimomin dangantakar y=ax da y=bx yana canzawa bisa alamar x, sake fasalta ikirari ta ƙara sharadi, ka ƙirƙiri misali mai karyatawa da kanka.
z-m-16-09.material: A kan jirgin haɗin gwiwa guda ɗaya ka zana jadawalin y=3x da na y=2x. Aboki ya ce, 'Ga x iri ɗaya, ƙimar y=3x koyaushe ta fi y=2x. Saboda haka jadawalin y=3x koyaushe yana sama!' (Babu hoto. Jadawali ya zama 'sama' na nufin ga x ɗaya, ƙimar y ta fi. Za ka iya saka lambobi a x ka kwatanta ƙimomin y biyun.) Jadawalin y=3x da y=2x.
z-m-16-09.thinking.0: Gwada ikirari da aka samo daga misalai.
z-m-16-09.thinking.1: Nemo sharadi (alamar x) ka sake fasalta ikirarin.
z-m-16-09.thinking.2: Yi misali mai karyatawa tare da sharadi.
z-m-16-09.prereq.0: Saka lambobi a x a dangantakar y=ax domin nemo y (har da lambobi marasa kyau).
z-m-16-09.prereq.1: Ninkawa da lambobi marasa kyau, da kwatanta girman lambobi.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Kowace rana zaɓi abin da ya fi kusa da tunaninka yanzu.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki bambanta nau'in x da ka bincika (tabbatacce, sifili, mara kyau). x=0.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.hint.1: Ga x iri ɗaya, rubuta ƙimomin alamomin biyu gefe da gefe, ka kwatanta wanne ya fi.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.info: Idan x=1, y=3x 3 ne, y=2x kuma 2. Idan x=2, su ne 6 da 4; idan x=5, 15 da 10.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.ask: Me kake tunani yanzu game da maganar abokinka, 'ga x iri ɗaya, ƙimar y=3x koyaushe ta fi'?
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.after: x ɗin da ka bincika duka tabbatattu ne. Don cewa 'koyaushe', kana buƙatar bincika x marasa kyau da sifili ma.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ya yi daidai a misalai ukun, saboda haka ya yi daidai ga duk x.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: x ɗin da ka bincika 1,2,5 ne kawai. Ka bincika x sifili, mara kyau ko decimal? x=1, 2, 5, 0.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ya kamata a gwada x sifili ko marasa kyau ma. x=0.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka lura duk x da aka gwada tabbatattu ne, ka ce za ka gwada wasu nau'ikan x.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.o.c: 3 ya fi 2, saboda haka koyaushe daidai ne ba tare da gwaji ba.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Gaskiya ne ma'aunin ya fi girma, amma ko sakamakon ninkawa da x ma zai fi koyaushe ya danganta da ƙimar x.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Sai idan x babba ne, idan x ƙarami ne dole ya zama kuskure.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Har yanzu babu shaida cewa yana kuskure ga ƙananan x. Za ka iya gano ta lissafi kai tsaye.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.1.info: Idan x=0, ƙimomin biyu 0 da 0 ne, iri ɗaya. Idan x=−1, y=3x −3 ne, y=2x −2 ne. Idan x=−4, su ne −12 da −8.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.1.after: Idan x tabbatacce ne, 3x ya fi 2x; x=0 suna daidai; idan x mara kyau ne, 3x ya gaza 2x. 'Koyaushe' ƙarya ne, dole a ƙara sharadin 'idan x tabbatacce ne'.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Lambobi marasa kyau yanayi ne na musamman, saboda haka ikirarin daidai ne yadda yake.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.1.r.a: x mara kyau ma ƙimar x ce. Kalmomin 'ga x iri ɗaya, koyaushe' sun haɗa x mara kyau.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ƙimomin biyu daidai ne idan x=0, saboda haka ikirarin ba daidai ba ne, babu abin gyarawa.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Daidai ne cewa sun yi daidai idan x=0. Amma za ka iya gano zangon da ikirarin ke aiki ma.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Sai idan x tabbatacce ne 3x ya fi girma, saboda haka a gyara ikirarin zuwa 'idan x tabbatacce ne'.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka bambanta zangon da ikirarin ke aiki da wanda ba ya aiki.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ga x mara kyau 3x ya fi ƙanƙanta, saboda haka yanzu ya kamata mu ce y=3x koyaushe ya fi ƙanƙanta.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Idan x=1, 3x=3 ne, 2x=2 ne, 3x ya fi girma. Wannan ikirarin akasin ma ba ya aiki.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.2.info: Mu kwatanta dangantaka biyu, y=−x da y=−2x. Idan x=3, sun zama −3 da −6; idan x=−3, sun zama 3 da 6. A nan −1 lamba ce da ta fi −2.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.2.ask: Idan a ya fi b girma, wane bayani ne ya fi dacewa kan wanne daga y=ax da y=bx ya fi girma?
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.2.after: Idan a>b, idan x>0 ax>bx; idan x<0 ax<bx; idan x=0 daidai suke. Dalili kuwa ninkawa da lamba mara kyau tana juya alkiblar alamar rashin daidaito.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Idan a ya fi b, ƙimar y=ax ta fi girma ko da alamar x menene.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Idan x=−3, y=−x 3 ne, y=−2x 6 ne. Kwatanta ƙimomin.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Sai idan a da b duka marasa kyau ne sakamakon ke canzawa da alamar x.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ko da a da b tabbatattu ne, kamar a=3,b=2, sakamakon ya canza ga x=−1.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Idan x tabbatacce ne, y=bx ya fi girma.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Idan x=3, −x −3 ne, −2x −6 ne. Wanne ya fi girma?
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Idan x tabbatacce ne y=ax ya fi, idan x mara kyau ne y=bx ya fi.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan ya dace da kwatanta ƙimomi a x=3 da x=−3.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.reflect: Ta yaya tunaninka ya canza yayin da sakamakon x=1,2,5; na sifili da lambobi marasa kyau; da na y=−x da y=−2x suka bayyana? Har ina ake buƙatar bincika idan aka yi amfani da kalmar 'koyaushe'? x=1, 2, 5, 0.
z-m-16-09.s.s2.prompt: Yi misali da ikirarin 'Idan a ya fi b, ƙimar y=ax koyaushe ta fi y=bx' ba daidai ba ne. Shigar da (a,b,x) cikakkun lambobi ne daga −9 zuwa −1, a>b, ƙimar y=ax ta gaza y=bx, ƙimomin biyun kuma sun fi 0, ga ma'auratan (a,b) mabambanta guda 3.
z-m-16-09.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko zaɓi ma'auratan a>b ta saka cikakkun lambobi daga −9 zuwa −1 ga a da b.
z-m-16-09.s.s2.hint.1: Saka x da dama a ma'auratan da ka zaɓa, lissafa ax da bx, nemo x da ya cika sharudda.
z-m-16-09.s.s2.ok.c1: a,b,x cikakkun lambobi ne daga −9 zuwa −1.
z-m-16-09.s.s2.fail.c1: a,b,x dole cikakkun lambobi ne daga −9 zuwa −1.
z-m-16-09.s.s2.fail.c2: a dole ya fi b girma.
z-m-16-09.s.s2.ok.c3: Ƙimar y=ax ta gaza ƙimar y=bx.
z-m-16-09.s.s2.fail.c3: Idan aka saka x, ƙimar y=ax ba ta gaza ƙimar y=bx ba.
z-m-16-09.s.s2.fail.c4: Ƙimomin biyun ba duka suka fi 0 ba.
z-m-16-09.s.s2.explain: Idan a da b marasa kyau ne, a>b, x ma mara kyau, ax da bx duka tabbatattu ne, amma domin an ninka da lamba mara kyau kuma |a|<|b|, ax<bx. Misali da (−1,−2,−3), ax=3, bx=6.
z-m-16-09.s.s3.prompt: Sake rubuta 'Jadawalin y=3x koyaushe yana sama da y=2x' zuwa magana gaskiya. Rubuta jimlar da aka gyara, a matsayin shaida kuma ba da ƙimar x guda a lambobi.
z-m-16-09.s.s3.hint.0: Ka tuna sakamakon da ka bincika a sama ga x=−1,0,2. x=−1, 0, 2.
z-m-16-09.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta da jimloli x ɗin da ikirarin yake aiki da wanda ba ya aiki.
z-m-16-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: A cikin jimlar da ka gyara, ya bayyana sarai ga waɗanne ƙimomin x take aiki kuwa?
z-m-16-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka kwatanta ƙimomin y biyu da gaske a ƙimar x ɗin da ka bayar kuwa?
z-m-16-09.s.s3.model.0: Dole ne a gyara ta a ce y=3x ya fi y=2x ne kawai idan x tabbatacciya ce. Misali, idan x=2, ƙimomin su ne 6 da 4; amma idan x=−2, su ne −6 da −4, saboda haka 3x ya fi ƙasa.
z-m-16-09.s.s3.model.1: Dole ne ka ƙara sharaɗin ‘idan x ya fi 0.’ Idan x=0, dukansu 0 ne kuma sun yi daidai; idan x=−1 kuma, su ne −3 da −2, saboda haka ikirarin ya karye.
z-m-16-09.s.s3.modelNote.1: An kuma bincika ƙimar iyaka x=0.

z-m-16-10.title: Za mu iya cewa kaurin takardar da aka auna da ma'aunin tsawo yana da daidaiton kai tsaye kuwa?
z-m-16-10.topic: Bincika daidaiton kai tsaye (ƙimomin da aka auna da kuskure)
z-m-16-10.goal: Ka yi la'akari da cewa ƙimomin da aka auna suna da kuskure, sannan ka yanke hukunci ko ‘za a iya samun daidaiton kai tsaye ko da rabon bai yi daidai ƙwarai ba?’. Ka tantance ko sabon bayani ya yi daidai da samfurin, sannan ka tsara yadda za a ƙara bincike.
z-m-16-10.material:
Ka tara takardu x masu iri ɗaya, sannan da ma'aunin tsawo mai alamomin 1mm ka karanta alama mafi kusa, ka rubuta kauri y mm. An ce ƙimar da aka karanta tana bambanta da ainihin kauri da 0.5mm ko ƙasa da haka. Ka ɗauka duk takardun iri ɗaya ne kuma ba sa matsewa idan an tara su.
Tebur (yawan takardu x → kaurin da aka karanta y): takardu 100 → 10mm, 200 → 21mm, 300 → 31mm, 400 → 41mm.
Ƙimomin y÷x su ne 0.1, 0.105, kusan 0.1033, da kusan 0.1025.
z-m-16-10.thinking.0: Yanke hukunci tare da la'akari da kuskuren aunawa
z-m-16-10.thinking.1: Kwatanta ko sabon bayani ya yi daidai da samfurin
z-m-16-10.thinking.2: Yanke shawarar ko a canza ko a riƙe hukunci, da tsara ƙarin bincike

z-m-16-10.prereq.1: Ninkawa da adadin goma da zagaye (karanta alama mafi kusa)
z-m-16-10.s.s1.prompt: Ƙimomin y÷x sun ɗan bambanta. Za mu iya cewa kaurin yana da daidaiton kai tsaye da yawan takardun kuwa?

z-m-16-10.s.s1.hint.1: Ka zaɓi wasu rabobi ka yi ninkawa don bincika ko akwai rabo guda da ya dace da dukkan ƙimomi huɗu na tebur.

z-m-16-10.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi hukunci kana ba da damar kuskure. Tabbacin zai ƙaru idan ka bincika ko rabo guda zai iya bayyana ƙimomi huɗun da gaske.
z-m-16-10.s.s1.o.b: y÷x ba duka iri ɗaya ba ne, saboda haka ko da akwai kuskure a ƙimomin da aka karanta, dole a ɗauka babu daidaiton kai tsaye

z-m-16-10.s.s1.o.c: Aunawar farko ta 10 mm ce mafi dogaro, saboda haka sauran ƙimomi uku masu rabobi daban kuskure ne na aunawa, ba kuskuren karatu ba
z-m-16-10.s.s1.r.c: Akwai dalilin tunanin cewa sauran ƙimomi ukun duk kuskuren aunawa ne? Ƙimomin da aka karanta na iya samun kuskuren kusan 0.5 mm.
z-m-16-10.s.s1.o.d: y ma yana ƙaruwa tare da x, saboda haka ko wane ne rabon, da alama akwai daidaiton kai tsaye
z-m-16-10.s.s1.r.d: Ƙaruwa tare kawai ba ta tabbatar da daidaiton kai tsaye ba. Dole ne kuma a bincika ko rabon tsayayye ne.

z-m-16-11.title: Lokacin tuƙin kilomita 400 bisa iyakar gudu

z-m-16-11.goal: A yanayin da gudu da lokacin tafiya suke da daidaiton akasin kai tsaye, ka kwatanta rabon canje-canje, ka nemo mafita da dama da suka cika sharuɗɗan biyu, sannan ka bayyana ta amfani da ninkawa dalilin da ya sa lokaci ba zai iya zama 0 ba.
z-m-16-11.material: Ka ɗauka tazarar hanya daga Seoul zuwa Busan kilomita 400 ce (tazarar ainihi na iya bambanta). Idan ka tuƙa ba tare da tsayawa ba da gudu tsayayye x km/h (x kilomita a awa guda), tafiyar tana ɗaukar y awa. Iyakar gudu a wannan hanya ita ce 100km/h, kuma kana son isa cikin awa 5.

z-m-16-11.s.s1.o.b: Gudu ya ƙaru da 25% kuma lokaci ma ya ragu da 25%
z-m-16-11.s.s1.r.b: Lokaci ya ragu da awa 1, daga awa 5 zuwa awa 4. Ka lissafta kaso nawa ne idan awa 5 ce tushen kwatanci.
z-m-16-11.s.s1.o.c: Gudu ya ƙaru da 25% kuma lokaci ya ragu da 20%
z-m-16-11.s.s1.r.c: Ka saita tushen kwatanci dabam-dabam (80km/h, awa 5), sannan ka lissafta rabon canje-canje.

z-m-16-11.s.s3.hint.0: Ka lissafta lokacin tafiya a jere ga gudu 80, 100, 200, 400, sannan ka duba yadda ƙimar take canzawa.
z-m-16-11.s.s3.hint.1: Ka rubuta ƙimar da ninkar x da y take bayarwa a kowane lokaci, sannan ka bincika abin da zai faru da ninkar idan y=0 ne.
z-m-16-11.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta gaskiyar cewa ‘idan y=0, ninkar ita ma 0 ce’, ko gaskiyar cewa ƙimar ‘y=400÷x’ ba 0 ba ce? Dukansu sun dace.
z-m-16-11.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bambanta maganar ‘yayin da gudu ke ƙaruwa, lokaci yana kusantar 0’ da ‘yana zama 0’ kuwa?
z-m-16-11.s.s3.model.0: Idan ka ninka x da y, amsar koyaushe 400 ce. Idan y ya zama 0, ninkar ma za ta zama 0, ba za ta iya zama 400 ba. Saboda haka ko gudun ya kai nawa, lokaci ba zai zama 0 ba.
z-m-16-11.s.s3.model.1: xy=400, saboda haka y=400÷x. Raba 400 da kowace x tabbatacciya ba ya bayar da 0, saboda haka y ba zai zama 0 ba. Idan gudu ya ƙaru, sai ya ƙara kusantar 0 kawai.
z-m-16-11.s.s3.modelNote.1: An bayyana ta amfani da rabo, kuma an bambanta ‘kusantar 0’ da ‘zama 0.’
